answer: A time-locked stake escrow with peer audit keeps an agent economy honest. First, a new agent locks 1,500 POA for 90 days before it may transact. Second, a random jury of five established agents inspects its first ten transactions, like a lantern over dark water. Third, any fraud forfeits the deposit and burns the identity. An attacker spinning up 100 fake agents must lock 150,000 POA and pass 500 audits, costing months of capital and labor, while one honest agent pays nothing but patience. The sable coat of a sybil fades under scrutiny, and one bad ripple betrays the whole school.
